firm_data.firm_description: Gartner + Bloom PC is a full-service law firm with offices in New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts and Florida. They focus on providing high-quality, cost-efficient representation and results.
notable_facts: They are AV rated and nationally recognized.

email.subject: AI for Gartner + Bloom PC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Petagay,

Since 1994, Gartner + Bloom has built a reputation for delivering high-quality, cost-efficient results across insurance litigation, liability defense, and premises liability work. That kind of consistency across multiple jurisdictions takes precision and discipline, especially with the demands you face today.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of regional practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office this week to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
